create_SMTStateEncoder: create an SMTStateEncoder transformer module for encoding scene memory states with configurable layers and attention heads
run_single_forward: run the single_forward method to encode observations against memory with optional goal conditioning and masking
encode_relative_pose: encode relative agent-to-memory poses using _encode_pose with relative coordinate transformation and time encoding
compute_relative_pose: compute relative pose between two agent poses in the reference frame of pose_a with heading normalization
format_pose: format a 4D pose tensor into 5D encoded representation with cos/sin heading and exponential time features
